tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Check whether domain names are available to register (up to 50 domains per call).

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Suggest available sending domains that look like the company's website (brand + one fitting word, e.g. acmehq.com, acme-partners.com), already checked for availability. Use this instead of inventing names.

tools.name: check_copy
tools.description: Check an email subject and body for spam trigger words before sending.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the workspace's sending domains with status, mailbox count and, for connected domains, DNS status and nameservers.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List the workspace's mailboxes (address, sender name, status). Never returns credentials.

tools.name: get_warmup_status
tools.description: Warm-up progress per mailbox (state, days warming, ready flag, ready date, inbox rate) and a workspace summary. Mailboxes can send campaigns once ready.

tools.name: list_sequencers
tools.description: List the workspace's connected sequencer accounts (Instantly, Smartlead) that mailboxes can be exported to.

tools.name: preflight_campaign
tools.description: Check whether a campaign can launch: sequence, contacts, attached mailboxes and their warm-up. Returns blocking checks with hints.

tools.name: get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Sending and engagement stats for one campaign (sent, replies, bounces).

tools.name: list_replies
tools.description: List recent threads where a contact replied (subject, sender, short snippet, reply intent). Paginate with cursor.

tools.name: connect_own_domains
tools.description: Connect domains the user already owns (free): returns the nameservers the user must set at their registrar. Calling again with the same domains is safe.

tools.name: start_warmup
tools.description: Start warm-up for mailboxes. Retrying with the same mailboxes the same day does not start a second operation.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign as a draft. Nothing is sent until launch_campaign.

tools.name: upsert_campaign_step
tools.description: Add an email step to a campaign sequence, or update one (by step_id, or by order when a step with that order exists). delay_days is the wait after this step before the next one.

tools.name: import_campaign_contacts
tools.description: Import contacts into a campaign from CSV text (header row with an email column; other columns become variables; up to 10000 rows). Pass import_id alone to check a previous import.

tools.name: attach_campaign_mailboxes
tools.description: Attach mailboxes to a campaign for sending. Only mailboxes that are ready to send (warm-up started 14+ days ago) are accepted.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Stop a campaign from sending. Safe to call again.

tools.name: launch_campaign
tools.description: Start sending a campaign to its contacts. Refused unless preflight is green and every attached mailbox is ready to send. Requires confirm=true after the user explicitly agrees.

tools.name: export_mailboxes_to_sequencer
tools.description: Send mailboxes' login credentials (SMTP/IMAP) to the user's third-party sequencer account (Instantly or Smartlead, from list_sequencers) so it can send from them. Omit mailboxes to export all eligible ones. Requires confirm=true after the user explicitly agrees. Large exports answer status pending a

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current prices: mailbox monthly price and minimum, domain prices by TLD, card processing fee rule, worked examples.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: What the workspace has (subscription, domains and mailboxes by state, warm-up, open orders, campaigns) and next_action: the one thing to do next. Start here.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Price new domains and mailboxes server-side. Creates a 15-minute quote; registers and charges nothing. Show human_summary to the user exactly before create_checkout. Ordering domains needs registrant with every one of: first_name, last_name, real_address, city, state_province, postal_code, country,

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Turn a quote the user explicitly confirmed into a Stripe payment page. Charges nothing: the user pays on the page. Requires confirm=true and the quote's due_now_cents.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Status of an order (payment, per-domain and per-mailbox setup, warm-up estimate) by order_id; without order_id, lists the workspace's recent orders.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_copy, get_warmup_status, list_replies, import_campaign_contacts · Private data: list_mailboxes, preflight_campaign, list_replies, import_campaign_contacts, launch_campaign, export_mailboxes_to_sequencer · Public sink: check_copy, get_warmup_status, upsert_campaign_step, import_campaign_contacts, attach_campaign_mailboxes, launch_campaign, export_mailboxes_to_sequencer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_copy, get_warmup_status, list_replies, import_campaign_contacts · Private data: list_mailboxes, preflight_campaign, list_replies, import_campaign_contacts, launch_campaign, export_mailboxes_to_sequencer · Public sink: check_copy, get_warmup_status, upsert_campaign_step, import_campaign_contacts, attach_campaign_mailboxes, launch_campaign, export_mailboxes_to_sequencer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
